producer: Locally authored ezdxf 1.4.4 R2010 LTYPE/LINE converted to AC1012 ASCII and Binary by installed ODA File Converter 27.1.0.0.
findings: Both R13 input encodings import the expected LTYPE into the actual LibreCAD adapter with both installed-current and bundled codecs.

The installed-current codec refuses re-export of the full ODA drawing at OBJECTS emission; before this change, the adapter discarded its diagnostic and falsely reported no DXF/DWG error. The bundled codec exports and passes the selected edited LTYPE and LINE readback checks; full object graph fidelity was not assessed.
An invalid SHAPE preflight independently produced the same missing-error symptom with both codecs.
change: Capture the newer codec structured failure message when available and fall back to a generic message for bundled codecs; preserve any earlier specific error, latch a nonzero error for output and shape-preflight failure, and clear state on retry.
validation: Both builds passed the three targeted binary-version, R13 and typed-writer failure tests: installed-current 286 assertions and bundled 292.
Failure cases preserve an existing destination, report a nonzero error and meaningful message, and the same filter succeeds and resets its error on retry.
Installed-codec LTYPE, PR #3269 and MLEADERSTYLE CTests pass; the bundled five PR #3269 cases pass.

The generator was run from scratch and both generated outputs passed the optional test with their actual header versions and encodings checked. A repeat invocation refused an existing output directory and preserved the generated hashes.

The patch replays after the preceding 40 patches; the two modified candidate files match byte-for-byte. The source-release inventory passes for 1247 files and its 18-control self-test passes. No drawings were committed.
limits: The optional R13 test is skipped unless both generated paths are supplied. The installed codec OBJECTS refusal remains unresolved; selected bundled readback does not establish whole-drawing preservation. Producer/version scope, GUI, Linux/Windows, upstream integration, and independent semantic support remain open. No phase gate or support claim is promoted.
